entries.scope: Canonical learner path and source/runtime ownership across Home Baseline and the sandbox image
entries.rationale: The learner entry path, required agent surfaces, target occupations, and the bounded container runtime-sync exception must match the implemented image contract.
readerPaths: Learner start to sandbox smoke test
entries.navigationImpact: The architecture now links to the concrete image documentation, while the learner guide links to both ownership layers.
entries.languageStrategy: German-first learner content with English text alternatives and a synchronized English architecture partner.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The documented smoke-test surface was compared with scripts/smoke-test-toolchains.sh in absdd-image-sandbox; source/runtime behavior is covered by the Home sync CLI tests.
entries.risk: Contradictory learner instructions could either block the approved runtime-only path or imply broader container writes.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The image changes its required agent set, learner occupations, embedded Home Baseline path, or runtime-sync wrapper contract.

entries.scope: Shared agent guidance, templates, and focused learner-guide propagation interface
entries.rationale: Runtime-distributed guidance and propagation tooling must express the same bounded exception and provide a safe guide-only rollout path.
entries.navigationImpact: The existing propagation manpage gains the focused shared-guide mode; no new top-level navigation is required.
entries.languageStrategy: Bilingual CLI help, manpage, and shared guidance with German first.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Bash syntax, PowerShell parser validation, deterministic guide-only fixture tests, and live dry-runs across the registered learning series cover the interface.
entries.risk: A broad propagation run could overwrite newer series-specific learning material; the focused mode stages only six exact guide paths per target.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The shared guide set, target layout, registry schema, or propagation safety gates change.

entries.scope: Generated script reference for the focused propagation interface
entries.rationale: The public Bash and PowerShell interface changes must be reflected in the deterministic script inventory.
entries.navigationImpact: The existing script-reference entry is regenerated from the updated public help.
entries.languageStrategy: The renderer derives bilingual descriptions from public script help.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The canonical renderer validates both entrypoints before replacing the generated reference.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The public propagation interface or script catalog mapping changes.
